'''2002 World Championship Top 8 Brian Fred LS Watch Your Step''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Brian Fred]] at [[2002 World Championship]] (Top 8), finishing 3rd; the list below is from the official Players Committee decklist form.<ref name="src">[http://www.theforce.net/ccg/sw/decks/fredLS.pdf SWCCG Players Committee decklist form: WYS Beats]</ref>

== Deck info ==

* '''Player:''' [[Brian Fred]]
* '''Event:''' [[2002 World Championship]]
* '''Stage:''' Top 8
* '''Finish:''' 3rd
* '''Side:''' [[Light]]
* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Watch Your Step / This Place Can Be A Little Rough|Ref2-L-watchyourstep.gif}}
* '''Deck name:''' WYS Beats
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Original VS3]]
* '''Source:''' [http://www.theforce.net/ccg/sw/decks/fredLS.pdf PC decklist form]
